note_comparison: LDV comparison is condition-level (RMS/peak/frequency per condition). Camera and LDV are compared condition-by-condition in the same tunnel from separate recording sessions on separate DAQ systems at different sampling rates (60 Hz vs 360 Hz).
note_bending_ratio: Bending cam/LDV ratio = 1.26× (stable mean, 19 conditions). The over-read reflects non-simultaneous acquisition, point-vs-spatial-averaging geometry, and residual timing uncertainty (see Discussion Sec. 5.2) — not a validated accuracy figure. Bending r = 0.960 (stable, 19 cond.).
note_torsion_proxy: torsion_diff_y_mm is a two-point differential displacement proxy, not a validated torsion angle measurement.
